note: Descriptions are the book's defining sentences, lightly trimmed.

attributes.name: Control
attributes.description: Defines characters who are precise, orderly, disciplined, highly coordinated, and who possess well-developed fine motor skills.

attributes.name: Daring
attributes.description: Defines characters who are decisive and fearless. When the adrenaline starts pumping, a Daring character can act swiftly and confidently.

attributes.name: Fitness
attributes.description: Defines characters by their physical prowess, athleticism, and endurance. A character with high Fitness is also more able to weather attacks and hazards.

attributes.name: Insight
attributes.description: Defines characters by their instincts and their perceptiveness. Insightful characters often have a good sense of the moods and feelings of others, and trust their own feelings when making decisions.

attributes.name: Presence
attributes.description: Defines characters by their strength of personality, and by their ability to draw attention and command respect. It also means a strong sense of self, allowing a character to resist coercion or manipulation.

attributes.name: Reason
attributes.description: Defines characters by their adherence to logic: meticulous analysis, detailed planning, the gathering of evidence, and the forming and testing of theories.
